description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans streaming functionality, specifically testing programmatic stream subscriptions using memory streams with multiple stream providers. It defines a test class 'MemoryProgrammaticSubcribeTests' that inherits from a test runner, includes a fixture class for test cluster configuration, and sets up memory stream providers for testing.
